hyperparams.title: Model hyperparameters
hyperparams.scoreThresholdHint: Drop detections below this score before NMS. Higher = fewer false positives.
hyperparams.targetFpsHint: Model sampling rate for live detection. The camera preview keeps its native smoothness; lower values skip more frames before inference.
hyperparams.preprocessProfileHint: Experimental morphology enhancement for models trained or validated with it. Model uses registry metadata and falls back to raw RGB.
hyperparams.morphFeatureHint: Turn on the experimental morphology-fused input path for Android live and TFLite photo inference. Leave off for models trained on raw RGB.
hyperparams.resetBody: All values revert to the shipped defaults.
